features:
🕶️ NONCHALANT ANIMATION PACK 🚀
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Transform your character's movement with the viral Nonchalant animation pack. This script smoothly replaces your default Idle, Walk, Run, Jump, Fall, and Climb animations using high-priority overrides for that smooth, effortless vibe.

✅ Smooth Transitions — Seamless switching between states without snapping.
✅ High Priority — Uses Action4 priority to override default game animations.
✅ Animation Bypass — Built-in resolver to load animations in games that normally block custom IDs.

2. Execute the script in your executor.
3. The animations will automatically apply to your character.
4. Move around, jump, fall, and climb ladders to see the Nonchalant pack in action!
